title: CRUD Operations Implementation
prerequisites: Familiarity with command pattern (request → handler → response)
Understanding of domain events and event sourcing
Knowledge of repository pattern for data access

inputs.description: Domain entity with CRUD requirements and business rules
items: Domain entity name (from Domain Modeling Skill)
List of CRUD operations needed (Create, Read, Update, Delete)
Query patterns for Read operations (by ID, by user, by email, etc.)
Domain events to publish upon state changes

outputs.description: Command classes, handlers, repository, and domain events for CRUD operations
items: Command handlers that execute business logic and publish events

successCriteria: All CRUD commands execute successfully with validation
Domain events published after each mutation operation
Business rules enforced at command handler level
All code compiles with zero warnings
Unit tests for command handlers pass with >80% coverage
nonGoals: Testing strategy (see Testing Skills for that)
